kebab_example: aliyun adb modify-materialized-view --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id amv-000000 --view-name mv_1 --db-name myDB --group-name res_1 --query-write true --enable-failure-alert false --enable-delay-alert false --latency-tolerance 2 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyMaterializedView

parameters.help_en: The name of the materialized view
parameters.name: view_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the database where the materialized view resides
parameters.help_zh: 物化视图所在数据库名称
parameters.name: db_name

parameters.help_en: The name of the resource group to which the materialized view is bound
parameters.help_zh: 物化视图绑定的资源组名称
parameters.name: group_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable query rewrite. Valid values:

*   true: Enables query rewrite.
*   false: Disables query rewrite
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启重写功能。取值如下： 
- true：是。 

- false：否
parameters.name: query_write

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to send alerts when the refresh task fails. Valid values:

*   true: Send alerts.
*   false: Alerts disabled
parameters.help_zh:
开启刷新任务失败告警。取值如下：

- true：是。 
- false：否
parameters.name: enable_failure_alert

parameters.help_en:
Enable the refresh delay alert. Valid values:

*   true: Enables alert.
*   false: Disables alert
parameters.help_zh:
开启刷新延迟告警。取值如下：

- true：是。
- false：否
parameters.name: enable_delay_alert
